title: Ubhaya Padangushtasana

sequence.action: Having reached the 7th vinyasa of Supta Padangushtasana, lie down and join the legs.
Straighten both legs, as in Sarvangasana.
As in Halasana, bring the legs up over the head, place the feet on the floor, and tightly take hold of the big toes.
Without letting go of the toes, roll forward and come to sit purely on the buttocks in the manner of Navasana, doing rechaka and puraka.
Remaining vinyasas as in earlier asanas.

while_holding: Both rechaka and puraka occur in the 8th vinyasa.
In the 9th vinyasa, do rechaka and puraka slowly and as much as possible, keeping the chest lifted and the stomach drawn in fully.
benefits: Purifies the anus, waist, stomach, genital organs, and the granthi traya (the three knots below the vina danda, beginning at the anal canal).
Eliminates the burning sensation that can occur during urination.
